description: This Java source file defines a custom exception class 'ReportMailingJobConfigurationNotFoundException' used in the Fineract project. It extends 'AbstractPlatformResourceNotFoundException' and is thrown when a report mailing job configuration with a specified name is not found. It includes two constructors: one accepting a configuration name and another that also accepts an underlying exception.
